mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5% and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in a month and the S&P 500 still produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for two consecutive months and the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals a monetary easing cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases for three consecutive months and the S&P 500 still produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously, but the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000 in a month and the S&P 500 still produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% in a quarter signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a late-cycle regime.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases by more than 0.5% in a quarter and the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances, especially during a late-cycle regime.
